correctedCandidate.en: An opinion can organize a pattern into a proposal. Keep the observed pattern separate from your interpretation, then invite a check of the details before treating that proposal as a dependable conclusion.

correctedCandidate.en: Ambition can focus attention on a larger role. Define the contribution you can make and the conditions of a fair exchange. Skills, resources and the other person’s choices still shape which opportunities are workable.
